motion.note: Body-quad reprojection error only; not a guarantee of identical lens/model or source tracking ground truth. First mostly offscreen frame is inferred. Source tracking is unavailable at 5.3s.

audio.note: Full original V13 MP3, no mix/EQ/gain/retiming edits. Encoded once to AAC for required MP4 format; not bit-identical audio.

limitations: Reference has no 5.3-second frame. Comparison marks it unavailable; no fabricated or repeated source frame.
First mostly-offscreen pose is inferred. Body-quad tracking measures projected movement, not identical lens/industrial design or aesthetic quality.
Source UI resolution is 691x1536. All original pixels retained; phone naturally extends outside canvas early in entry.
Full V13 is 20.48 seconds, so output lasts 20.5 seconds. After source movement ends, final phone pose holds; other scenes are not generated.
Audio encoded once from original MP3 to required AAC; waveform/timing verified, not a bit-identical stream copy.
Technical QA pass is not a claim of identical physical design or agency-level aesthetic quality.
